Changes:

* **New home-screen widget** — the next launches and your subscribed events, at a glance. Resize it for more rows, tap one to open it.
* **Follow keywords** — add "Starship" or "Falcon" and you are subscribed to matching launches automatically, as they are announced.
* **Works offline, and opens instantly.** Everything you have seen before is shown straight away and refreshed in the background, instead of waiting on the network.
* **Redesigned launch and event pages** — a large photo, a live countdown and the details laid out as cards, including reused boosters, pad history and provider stats.
* **A rebuilt news feed** with compact cards, and a proper news search that keeps your place when you come back from an article.
* **Launch times now say how precisely they are known** — "NET October 2026" rather than inventing a day that is not real yet.
* **Better notifications** — you are told when a launch time actually changes, reminders say where it is lifting off from, and they work again on Android 14 and newer.
* **A new floating bottom bar**; tapping the tab you are already on jumps back to the top of the list.
* **Much less storage used.** Images are stored and decoded at the size they are shown, news thumbnails are cleared after a week, and the cache can no longer grow without limit.
* **Proper layouts on tablets, in landscape and at large font sizes**, with columns instead of one enormous card.
